_doc: The living half of the CARPAL-BLOOM-002 page. The card's URL is burned into a chip and can never change, so this page is the only place depth can accumulate: someone who taps the card again next month should find something that was not here today. Adding an entry is a JSON edit and a deploy — never a new page and never a new URL. Newest first. Every number here is on the page above or is arithmetic on numbers that are; nothing here was measured off a built object, because nobody has built one.

entries.en: At 97% the fit holds and the cuff shrinks
entries.body_en: Step 01 says a 97% print leaves all twelve joints loose. Both halves are on the same sheet, so both shrink: the 12.0 mm tab becomes 11.6 mm and the 12.4 mm slot 12.03 mm. The gap only drops to 0.39 mm — what shrinks 3% is the cuff.

entries.en: Nothing on the sheet is longer than 180 mm
entries.body_en: The A2 is the size of the drawing, not of any part on it. The longest thing on it is 180 mm: the petal is 180.0 × 35.0 mm and each cuff band is 180.0 mm. Print the full A2 template either way — it carries the ruler you check the scale against.
